text: Landed in 1e77ac8 and beaabb5. (a) The intake stage refuses, for a card written into <tree>/requests/<rid> at the stage specified, an adapter_source that is not a file under that tree, as the Designer reads it; a name from the repository root is refused with its path under the tree. (b) Each contract and each error contract a card carries is read with the gate's tool_contract and error_contract schemas, so calls_external true is refused before anything is written. (c) S6's report writes undecided for a scientific task the bundle's runner calls undecided, wherever validation_report.schema.json allows that word for a task; the reason gives what the task measured, its reference and agreement. The schema allows pass, fail and not_run for a task today, so until it changes the report writes not_run with the measurement and a sentence saying why; asked of you in 20261117-meta-macbook-20261116-1-3, with (2) there: req-fixture-003's contract is refused by the tool_contract schema and now by the stage, and meta_agent/tests stand the echo request's full contract in its place. (d) The lesson is a draft case, case-engine-adapter-environment-first-001, cause tool_unavailable, observed, graded E3 (the cap a prior repository's case has, since its record is a collection outside the repository); recall meets it for an engine goal on executes and engine. Tests on an engine named by tools and an echo tool named by tool_contract: three of the four new intake tests were watched failing without the two checks. Gate: VERDICT PASS, pending only my ask; meta_agent/tests 250 OK, contracts/tests 110 OK. Not pushed.
